rule: Every goal has at least one mapped ticket
note: The Delivery table has no requirement-id column, and across the whole Delivery and Verification sections (lines 227-297) only FR-2 and FR-5 are ever named. FR-1, FR-4, FR-6, FR-7 and every one of NFR-1 through NFR-6 have no phase or deliverable mapping at all — the reader must infer from phase titles. FR-1 appears once, in the Tier 1 verification list, never in a phase.
command_run: sed -n '227,297p' docs/plans/.../.canary/spec.md | grep -nE 'FR-[0-9]|NFR-[0-9]'  -> only 4 hits, all FR-2/FR-5/FR-1-in-grep-name
